directly about elections in early 1970s."},{"title":"Bundestagswahl 1976 (German Federal Election Study 1976)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0833","justification":"Core GESIS dataset on the 1976 German federal election with voter attitudes and behavior; key election in mid‑1970s."},{"title":"Bundestagswahl 1980 (German Federal Election Study 1980 – including late‑1970s political context)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1198","justification":"Post‑election study for the 1980 federal election; many variables and retrospective questions cover party competition and voter evaluations shaped over the late 1970s."},{"title":"Politische Einstellungen, politische Partizipation und Wählerverhalten 1973","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0827","justification":"Study of political attitudes, participation, and voting behavior in the Federal Republic of Germany in 1973, closely tied to electoral politics between the 1969 and 1972/1976 elections."},{"title":"Europawahl 1979 (European Election Study 1979 – Germany)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1170","justification":"German component of the 1979 European Parliament election; focuses on electoral behavior and party preferences at the end of the 1970s."},{"title":"Landtagswahlen in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland 1970–1979 (State Election Data)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA2004","justification":"Aggregated dataset on state (Landtag) elections in West Germany during the 1970s, covering electoral results across Länder."},{"title":"Politische Kultur und Wahlen in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland 1977","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0936","justification":"Study connects political culture and electoral orientations in 1977, in the run‑up to late‑1970s and 1980 elections."},{"title":"Kommunalwahlen in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland 1970–1979","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA3002","justification":"Election results and related indicators for local (municipal) elections in West Germany during the 1970s."},{"title":"German Longitudinal Election Study – Historical Predecessor: Politische Einstellungen und Wählerverhalten 1976 (Panel)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0835","justification":"Panel-style election study around the 1976 Bundestag election capturing voter attitudes and turnout over time in the 1970s."},{"title":"Wahlstudie Bundesrepublik Deutschland 1970 (Pre‑electoral Attitudes and Party Preferences)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0670","justification":"Early‑1970s election‑related study on party preferences and turnout intentions in the Federal Republic of Germany."}]}
